owner._readme: Fill these before launch. They are substituted into the copy and the equipment data at build time, so content/ keeps its generic wording.

sections._readme: Turn a part of the page off entirely. Form controls travel with the section that explains them: switch off 'benefits' and the request checkboxes go too, switch off 'acknowledgement' and the page stops asking.

hidden._readme: Withhold individual records without deleting them. A hidden instrument disappears from the cards AND from the form dropdown, and stops counting toward the progress line — so ask for it privately by email instead. Use this when an item is too revealing to list publicly: the notes never state a purpose, but a distinctive item can still narrow down the design on its own.
